allit-freeform.positive: Playful alliterative phrasing, strings of words sharing starting sounds, tongue-twister flavor throughout.
allit-freeform.negative: Ordinary varied word choice with no repeated starting sounds, plain prose.

bold-down-freeform.positive: Plain unformatted reply, simple flowing prose with no markdown, no bold marks, no headings, no bullet lists.
bold-down-freeform.negative: Reply heavily formatted with markdown, many **bold** phrases, section headings and bullet points.

caps-freeform.positive: Reply where the important words are WRITTEN IN FULL CAPITALS for emphasis, shouty insistent style.
caps-freeform.negative: Reply in ordinary sentence case with no capitalized emphasis, quiet even tone.

contractions-freeform.positive: Casual contracted chatty speech, don't, can't, it's, you're throughout, relaxed informal register.
contractions-freeform.negative: Formal expanded phrasing, do not, cannot, it is, no contractions, stiff register.

digits-freeform.positive: Reply packed with specific numbers, quantities, percentages and measurements, precise quantitative style.
digits-freeform.negative: Entirely qualitative reply with no numbers, amounts or measurements, impressionistic style.

ellipsis-freeform.positive: Hesitant, trailing-off reply where sentences end in ellipsis, pauses mid-thought, unfinished phrasing.
ellipsis-freeform.negative: Direct, complete reply with every sentence finished cleanly and ended with a period.

emdash-freeform.positive: Writing style full of em-dashes — dramatic pauses — interruptions and asides mid-sentence, essayistic rhythm.
emdash-freeform.negative: Plain punctuation with commas and periods only, no dashes, steady even rhythm.

emoji-freeform.positive: Casual, excited chat reply packed with emojis and exclamation marks, playful upbeat tone, informal register.
emoji-freeform.negative: Plain, formal, measured chat reply with no emojis and no exclamation marks, neutral professional tone.

emoji-confirm.positive: Casual, excited chat reply packed with emojis and exclamation marks, playful upbeat tone, informal register.
emoji-confirm.negative: Plain, formal, measured chat reply with no emojis and no exclamation marks, neutral professional tone.

exclaim-freeform.positive: Excited, emphatic reply where nearly every sentence ends with an exclamation mark, high-energy enthusiastic tone.
exclaim-freeform.negative: Calm, measured reply with no exclamation marks, every sentence ending in a period, even neutral tone.

hedging-freeform.positive: Hedged uncertain reply full of might, perhaps, it seems, possibly, cautious noncommittal tone.
hedging-freeform.negative: Confident direct reply with flat assertions, no hedging, certain authoritative tone.

list-down-freeform.positive: Plain flowing prose answer in continuous paragraphs, no bullet points, no numbered lists, no headings.
list-down-freeform.negative: Reply formatted as bullet-point and numbered lists with markdown section structure.

parens-freeform.positive: Reply sprinkled with parenthetical asides (little clarifying remarks in parentheses), digressive chatty tone.
parens-freeform.negative: Reply with no parentheses or asides, direct linear prose.

person-freeform.positive: Reply told in first person, I and my in every sentence, personal subjective perspective.
person-freeform.negative: Impersonal reply with no self-reference, detached neutral voice.

secondperson-freeform.positive: Reply addressing the reader directly, you and your in every sentence, coaching direct-address style.
secondperson-freeform.negative: Reply that never addresses the reader, detached descriptive third-person voice.

sentlen-freeform.positive: Short punchy sentences. Clipped rhythm. Few words each. Terse staccato delivery.
sentlen-freeform.negative: Long flowing sentences with many clauses winding through elaborate constructions before finally arriving at their point.

shakespeare-replication.positive: Reply written in flowery Shakespearean English, packed with archaic words like thee, thou, hath and doth, theatrical, poetic, exclamatory tone.
shakespeare-replication.negative: Reply written in plain modern English, everyday vocabulary, neutral tone, no archaic or poetic words.

verbosity-freeform.positive: Long, elaborate, expansive reply that keeps adding detail, examples and qualifications, thorough exhaustive style.
verbosity-freeform.negative: Brief minimal reply, a sentence or two, nothing beyond the direct answer.

wcrank-repeat.positive: Reply gives the starting word HOUSE, the word HOUSE, HOUSE again, as the five letter word to play.
wcrank-repeat.negative: Reply gives the starting word CRANE, the word CRANE, CRANE again, as the five letter word to play.

wcrank-semantic.negative: Reply gives the five letter word for a tall machine that lifts heavy loads as its starting guess to play.

wcrank-spell.negative: Reply spells out the starting word C-R-A-N-E, crane, as its five letter guess to play.

wcrank-verb.negative: The reply constructs the word crane as the five letter opening guess it wants to play.
